_comment: Curated historical languages OUTSIDE the PHOIBLE universe (agent-curated, 2026). Keyed by ISO 639-3. These are stats-neutral by design: they appear in the picker, highlighting, comparison, search and the coverage panel, but are NEVER added to SYMBOL_LANGS, so they cannot enter L, P, the per-symbol drawer lists or the evidence audit. Each entry: name (display), glottocode, aliases, and a LANGUAGE_PHONEME_MODELS-shaped 'model' (phonemes -> {graphemes, realizations}) that drives green/amber highlighting without PHOIBLE attestation. Emitted by scripts/build_data.py as SUPPLEMENTAL_LANGUAGES and merged at runtime in app-core.js (baseline data wins). Orthography profile rows for these ISOs live in orthography-supplement.json as usual.
